title: Spatial Methods Workbench
description:
Spatial Methods Workbench is a citation-aware R Shiny environment with 12 guided workflows for spatial autocorrelation, conditional networks, spatially adjusted 2D and 3D networks, prediction, clustering, image-regression screening, mediation, and statistical shape analysis.

The release contains complete usage and installation guidance, function-level pipeline documentation, direct adapters to the public ISPAT, GP-GHS, and ISPAT-3D engines, reproducibility bundles, and 36 automated checks. The application reports statistical output without automatically assigning biological, clinical, or causal meaning.

Required attribution

Users must cite this software release and the method-specific publications or software applicable to the workflow used. The complete bibliography is included in REFERENCES.md and in result bundles. Public forks used during development are credited to both their upstream projects and Sagnik Bhadury's forks: Microsoft AI for Beginners, Microsoft ML for Beginners, Deep Understanding of Deep Learning, SV-NN, STCAR, and SBLF. Curriculum and related-method repositories are not presented as exact statistical engines.

No private repository, working manuscript, or unpublished method idea is described by this record.
